lines.zh: 翼膜兜着山风，我滑下去。
lines.en: My wing membrane cups the mountain wind as I glide down.
One beat of my wings and I am airborne.
I skim low along the ridge.
I tuck my claws and settle on the rock.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的天，还在我头上。
lines.en: The Cretaceous sky is still above me.
The wind over Brazil tastes different.
I waddle along, awkward on the ground.
My wingtips brush the tops of the grass.
I hunt above the plain.
I skim low, wingtips making no sound.
I bank into the rising air.
My long beak points down as I search.
My wings are too wide; walking is hard work.
Another hop, and then I am up.
I stand on the crag without moving.
The wind holds me up; I cannot be bothered.
The teeth in my beak are like fine pegs.
I tilt my head to listen.
The air here is steady.
I stare at the water far off.
My crest catches the light in the wind.
There is a tear in my wing membrane.
I wait for a stronger gust.
It is cold up here, but I am used to it.
Hear my shriek before you look up.
I saw you first.
Hide behind a tree? It is too short.
I am gauging how fast you run.
These eyes rarely blink.

lines.zh: 你手里那块石头，是冲我来的？
lines.en: Is that stone in your hand meant for me?
I know what prey looks like.
Do not wave; that trick is wasted on me.
On a mountain path you will not get far.
Wings tucked tight, ready to launch.
It hurts; my wing is askew.
I shriek, and the valley answers.

lines.zh: 翼膜被打穿了，飞起来漏风。
lines.en: My wing membrane is pierced; it whistles in flight.
My wing membrane hangs crooked.
Light bones take heavy damage.
A few wing fibres came loose.
I can still fly. Give me a moment.
I drag my wings back a step.
You picked the wrong bird.
Blood runs down my beak.
Toss the meat higher - I'll take it midair.
The smell of meat cuts through the wind.

lines.zh: 在你头顶，我盘了一圈半。
lines.en: I wheel one and a half turns above you.
Raw meat. My favourite.
Keep your hand steady; I can see it.
Land, fold my wings, come closer.
This much meat is barely a mouthful.
I circle and watch you set the meat down.
Raise it, and I will come down.
Hunger is overtaking my caution.
My beak finds your collarbone first.
My wing sweeps past and you stagger back.
I hit the cliff and see stars.
I land too hard and the dust bursts up.
Do not stand where I land.
That knock left me dazed.
I graze past above your head.
Bone meets bone with a crack.
You knocked me off my line.
Stand firm and give me another.
I spread my wings and show my colours.
Answer me, the one circling above.

lines.zh: 并着翅膀，一起借山谷的上升气流。
lines.en: Wings side by side, we ride the valley updraft.
The ledge is wide enough for two.
I call out, sharp and long.
Easy now, do not bump me.
The nest belongs on the highest rock.
Our young should fly higher than I do.

lines.zh: 翼尖一触，空中就算应了。
lines.en: Wingtips touch - that's a yes in the air.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的规矩，我还守着。
lines.en: I still keep the Cretaceous way.
Hind claws grip, foreclaws tear.
Caught in midair, just right.
Too small a bite; it lodges in my teeth.
Whatever drops on the slope is mine.
Swallowed whole - why waste the teeth.
I carry it off under my wing.
Anything that moves, I want a bite of.
It's harder than my needle teeth.
I will carry it off and eat at leisure.
Snatched is mine.

lines.zh: 你抬脚那刻，我已经动了。
lines.en: The moment you lifted a foot, I moved.
The target is right below.
I've picked out the back of your neck.
I have taken you into my sight.
The wind shifted you half a step.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，我感觉到了。
lines.en: I can feel the warmth coming off you.
Wings folded, beak lined up.
I swing around behind you.
Running will not get you clear.
My shadow is over you now.
This highland is my hunting ground.
My beak points at you.
Three wingbeats is all it takes.
One snapped branch pointed the way.
I am above you. Do not look up.
I am taking off.
I glide after your footsteps.
These Cretaceous wings still work.
I spiral down, circle after circle.
I drop below the treetops.
I can hear you panting.

lines.zh: 林子里我追不进去，但会等。
lines.en: The trees stop me, but I will wait.
I am waiting for you to tire.
The second dive will be more accurate.
I keep my eye on that one spot.
You change direction too slowly.
One circle cuts off your retreat.
The wind helps me and hinders you.
Stopping makes you a target.
I am working out your speed.
Looking up for me?
My wings hold their angle.
You are running toward the cliff.
This pass, I fly low enough.
Patience is a hunter's tool.
My beak is nearly on you.
The beak stabs down.
Claws grip first, teeth after.
I cut in from your upper flank.
A wing bone cracks against your shoulder.

lines.zh: 再扇一翅，我绕回你头顶。
lines.en: One wingbeat brings me back overhead.
That shove of mine put you back.
I bite down on your armour.
Fine teeth tear a gash open.
I use gravity to drive the blow.
Leap, fold, land.
Whatever you held, you dropped it.
My teeth graze past, taking only blood.
I come around behind you again.
A shriek, then another lunge.
The smell of blood excites me.
You guard above but not your flank.
My claws rake down, deep.
Your shield throws me off.
I make a second pass.
You will not last long.

lines.zh: 热流把我从谷底托起来。
lines.en: Thermals lift me out of the valley floor.

lines.zh: 一片翼影落在你们头顶。
lines.en: A wing's shadow falls over your heads.
My wings unfold in the cold air.
I have landed on this plain.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的翼，飞进了今日。
lines.en: Cretaceous wings, flying into today.
The crag is my perch.
The wind is right, and here I am.
A shriek splits the valley.
My health is thin, but enough.
The coast of Brazil is out of sight.
I will look from up high first.
This highland suits me.
I fold my wings and land near you.
Lift your head.
The flames touch my wing, and I panic.
I hit the ground too hard and groan.
This is no place to spread wings.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的翼膜掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast flips my wing membrane.
The arrow is lodged in my wing bone.
This strange force numbs my bones.
Hunger has made my flight unsteady.
Lightning hit me; my feathers are scorched.

lines.zh: 这里没有风，我托不住自己。
lines.en: There is no wind here to hold me up.
